messages:
maria: quick heads-up — LangChain connector call with Gateway partner tomorrow 10am PT. want an ops-handshake for marketplace listing + hw compatibility. cc @dave @anika

dave: ack. Agenda ideas?

maria: top ones: 1) auth/token scopes for marketplace listing; 2) perf baseline on partner infra (A100/H100); 3) SDK adapter changes (langchain + llama-index); 4) announcement timing & co-marketing; 5) validation/test harness and CI.

anika: add fallback routing semantics — how dedicated vs hosted routes behave when gateway returns 503s.

chris: for the hw partner we need their quantized model variants and perf tables. requested from @hw-team earlier, flagged as urgent.

hw-bot: hw-team uploaded: https://s3.company.com/partners/gateway/hw-quant-report-v2.pdf (perf + quant tables)

maria: thanks. For the ops checklist I want a minimal compatibility matrix: route name, required env vars, model-ids supported, quant flags, and fallback policy. I'll sketch it after the call.

dave: proposed test matrix rows: `endpoint, model-id, seq-len, batch-size, quant, fallback-policy`. we should run smoke CI that hits real gateway staging. example job:```
./ci/run-marketplace-integration.sh --provider=gateway --hw=h100 --matrix=smoke
```

anika: +1. Also document the expected latency SLOs per route and what triggers failover to hosted models.

beth-sales: legal/co-marketing note — need logo use + partner quote signoff. I'll circle legal and get a checklist by EOD Friday.

maria: timeline proposal: draft ops checklist today, sync tomorrow after call, perf baseline by Thu, announcement earliest week of May. realistic?

chris: depends on HW numbers. if H100 quantized variant is >15% slower than A100 baseline we should either delay or mark as "beta" on marketplace.

dave: action items: maria -> draft ops checklist + compatibility matrix; chris -> quantify perf gaps and upload results; anika -> document routing/fallback behaviors; beth-sales -> legal/co-marketing signoff. we'll track in branch `partners/langchain-gateway/ops-handshake`.

maria: note: keep marketplace listing minimal to avoid extra QA cycles — mark as "beta" if needed and enable feature flags.

anika: also agree to record CI logs and artifacts to S3 prefix `s3://partners/langchain-gateway/ci/1784012345/` for audit.

beth-sales: will ping if we need partner comms templates or an embargo window.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
